Begin _powerSurgeExploder1

short state	
float posiz
float timer				

; -- -- Frost Block Trigger Menumode Block
if ( MenuMode == 1 )
	Return
endif


if ( GetDisabled == 1 )
	if ( state <= 200 )
		set state to ( state + 1 )
		Return
	else
		setdelete 1
		DontSaveObject
		Return
	endif
endif

; -- -- Frost Block Trigger Spell Block
if ( state == 0 )
	ExplodeSpell "_power_surge"
	set state to 1
	Return
elseif ( state == 1 )
	set timer to (timer + GetSecondsPassed)
	if(timer > 1)
		set state to 2
		Disable
	endif
	Return
endif

End

begin _tree_lever1

;each lever gets a script that controls itself, and moves the door based on the door's
;local state (each door has LocalState script on it).
;sounds should be tagged in animations

	set move to 1
	set tree_online to 1
endif

	;animate the lever
	if ( state == 0 )

			set state to 1
	else
			playgroup "idle3"

	endif


	set move to 0

endif

begin _war_Lift2

float timer
float angle
short start

if(war_vendermachine == 1)
	enable
else
	disable
endif

if(GetDeadCount "sotha_vendingmachine" == 1)

if ( MenuMode == 1 )
	return
	;don't run time in Menu Mode. Very bad.
endif

if ( OnActivate == 1)
	if ( start == 0 )
		playgroup "idle2"
		set start to 1
	endif
	return
	;when activated, we want to start movement on the next frame...
endif

if ( start == 0 )
	return
	;if we have't started, stop here for speed
endif

if ( timer < 10)
	if ( timer > 1 )
		if ( start == 1 )
			PlaySound "FabBossGyro"
			Set start to 2
		endif
	endif
	war_elevator-> MoveWorld Z, 125
	;above two lines open the doors.
	;you may need to adjust the times or the rotate value.
	;right now they open over 9 seconds to about 100 degrees.
endif

if ( timer > 10 )
	if ( start == 2 )
		Set start to 3
	endif
	Player-> PositionCell 4251, 4663, 14837, 0, "Sotha Sil, Residential District, Kummuuuu's Emporium"
endif


set timer to ( timer + GetSecondsPassed )

endif

end

Begin DNO_Ladder_dn_Script

short messageOn

MessageBox "Do you want to climb down this ladder?" "Yes" "No" 

set messageOn to 1 
endif 

if ( messageOn == 1 ) 
set button to GetButtonPressed 
;resets the variable so you can use the door multiple times

set messageOn to 0 
endif 

;should send you through the door normally
 
if ( button == 0 )

; should just reset the script, allowing you to do it again
 
elseif ( button == 1 ) 
          set button to 0 
          return 
     endif 
endif

begin extremeFloat

float  	timer
float	swingTime
float	swingSpeed
float	startAngle

;set startAngle to GetStartingAngle, x

if ( MenuMode == 0 )

	set swingTime to (Random, 100) + 1
	;set swingSpeed to 30

	set timer to ( timer + GetSecondsPassed )

	;rotate up
	if ( timer < swingTime )

		Rotate x,10
		Move z, 10

	;rotate down

	elseif ( timer < (swingTime * 3) )

			Rotate x, -10
			Move z, -10
	;up again
	elseif (timer < (swingTime * 4 ) )
		Rotate x, 10
		Move z, 10		

	;reset timer to zero
	else
		set swingTime to (Random, 10) + 1
		set timer to 0
		SetAtStart

	endif

endif

end Float
